long_biography.plain_text:
Before entering business, Alexander Machkevitch studied philology at Kyrgyz State University and began an academic career. He completed postgraduate research in education and became a university dean while still in his twenties. During perestroika he moved into commerce, exchanging the lecture hall for the emerging private economy.

Beyond industry, Machkevitch became an organiser of Jewish communal life across Eurasia. He founded the Jewish Congress of Kazakhstan in 2000 and was the first president of the Euro-Asian Jewish Congress, helping connect communities across the former Soviet Union, Europe and Asia. His philanthropy supported synagogues, mosques and churches in Kazakhstan, alongside Holocaust education and remembrance.
long_biography.html:
Before entering business, Alexander Machkevitch studied philology at Kyrgyz State University and began an academic career. He completed postgraduate research in education and became a university dean while still in his twenties. During perestroika he moved into commerce, exchanging the lecture hall for the emerging private economy.

Beyond industry, Machkevitch became an organiser of Jewish communal life across Eurasia. He founded the Jewish Congress of Kazakhstan in 2000 and was the first president of the Euro-Asian Jewish Congress, helping connect communities across the former Soviet Union, Europe and Asia. His philanthropy supported synagogues, mosques and churches in Kazakhstan, alongside Holocaust education and remembrance.

uncertainties.detail: No reliable source located establishes material family wealth, family-business experience or family financing at Machkevitch's start. The narrower advantaged subtype instead rests on the trio's documented shared platform: Chodiev's senior-government introduction led to the state management contract from which their core Kazakh mining acquisitions developed, while Trans-World Group supplied some initial financing. The dossier attributes that access to the partnership and does not convert later political links, disputed characterisations or absence of inheritance evidence into a claim of an independent start.

Machkevitch died in March 2025 and therefore has no current personal holdings. Evidence establishes indirect ERG participation and an EFC interest before death, followed by inheritance and a May 2026 sale of the heirs' 20.7% ERG interest. Primary industry is Unknown under the contract's current-personal-wealth definition; Metals & Mining is retained as a review candidate only if policy instead uses the final identifiable lifetime industry.

The Kazakhstan finance ministry stated that Machkevitch was not a direct individual shareholder and participated through a controlled foreign legal entity whose name was not public. The dossier describes an indirect interest and does not convert founder or board status into direct personal ownership.

Patokh Chodiev and Alijan Ibragimov were Machkevitch's business partners, not interchangeable co-owners. Current records concern Chodiev, the Ibragimov family, Machkevitch's widow and daughters, and later Nature Energy Solutions; none of those current interests is attributed to Machkevitch.

Eurasian Bank confirms that Machkevitch's heirs registered inheritance rights in EFC in April 2026. Public reporting describes financial-company holdings separate from ERG, but no complete estate valuation supports treating finance as his final dominant industry.

The exact dedicated Forbes profile is verified and now marks Machkevitch deceased, but its substantive wealth figures and company description were last updated in 2019. It supports identity, wealth origin and creation industry, not current ownership.

Forbes establishes Israeli citizenship and reliable reporting describes an Israeli-Kazakh identity, while the source record stores Russian as primary nationality and Kazakhstanian as secondary. Russian is proposed for correction to Israeli; the existing Kazakhstanian secondary nationality is preserved. Strong sources place his birth in Frunze, Kyrgyzstan, so the stored Kazakhstan birth country is proposed for correction.
